conversation--saved-history-compact-dark.task: Scan saved conversations and their facts beside the complete saved reply.
conversation--saved-history-compact-dark.observations: The selected title and inline facts are clear; the draft has a complete readable textarea and the collapsed draft occupies one row. Desktop shows the short saved reply in full. Compact exposes its beginning and requires ordinary scrolling for the rest; a reading-position capture follows.
